protocol.test_policy: official test evaluation, predictions, and metrics are closed during selection and ablation; evaluated only by confirmatory full_train

dataset_identity.manifest_policy: record split fingerprints, index hashes, class counts, synsets and label hashes

reproducibility.experiment_id: SHA256(canonical training config + source + dataset contract + environment + package lock)
reproducibility.resume_behavior: completed folds are skipped by atomic done.json; an incomplete fold is cleaned and restarted from epoch 1 without an epoch checkpoint

notes: f1 and f3 are ablations, not primary methods.
f2 was selected by a preregistered parsimony rule: near-f3 validation performance without a second independent gate.
Test metrics must not be used to change the locked primary method or hyperparameters.
Alpha-bound sensitivity at alpha_min 0.01, 0.025 and 0.05 is reported in separate experiment IDs.
ImageNet-100 uses the clane9/imagenet-100 CMC 160-pixel source; 224 is supported as an explicit resize but is not native-resolution evidence.
PReLU means scalar shared PReLU; PReLU-Channel is an optional separately named control.
LGTS learnability ablations use --lgts_learning both, alpha, beta and none in separate experiment IDs.
Epoch checkpoints are intentionally disabled by researcher decision; interrupted folds restart from epoch 1 and completed folds resume via atomic done.json.
